(2,4,6-Trimethylphenyl)gold
is a member of a special group of compounds where an
aryl
carbon atom acts as a bridge between two
gold
atoms. This compound is formed in a reaction between Au(CO)Cl and the
Grignard reagent
mesitylmagnesium bromide.

1
]
It crystallizes as a cyclical
pentamer
.
